move: liquid orange blob face wobbles, eyes squash-blink, mouth stretches wide, ring swells out
how: A pure canvas drawing on a yellow field: 26 dark specks orbit the centre on seeded radii; a big orange metaball-style blob (90-point polygon whose radius wobbles with sine lobes driven by t) with a lighter inner blob, both squashing scaleX 1+.07sin(2p) and rotating +-0.08rad on a slow breath; two dark blob eyes with yellow highlights that drift and blink (scaleY collapsing to .1) around 45% of the loop; a bezier mouth whose corner width swings 150-250px and whose drop swells with a 12px wobble, a pink tongue blob clipped inside it; and a dark outline ring that expands from r 380 to 640 while its line thins and fades once per loop. Every quantity is a periodic function of p = t/5, so frame 150 equals frame 0.
adapt: Change the four colours (yellow field, orange blobs, dark ink, pink tongue), the speck count and the blob radii; the eye and mouth positions are hard offsets from centre. Keep the sine-driven wobble frequencies and the single blink at 45%.
port: mount(el, shot) appends a canvas sized to el and stores the seeded specks; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap timeline holding one tween of a {p:0}->{p:1} proxy over D with onUpdate calling the draw(p) function, since this is an fx.register seek loop rather than GSAP tweens. The draw assumes a 1080x1080 canvas with centre 540,540; scale the context by el size.
caveats: canvas seek loop: port as a proxy tween with onUpdate
the ring swell uses (p*1.0)%1 so it snaps at the loop point, by design
catalog says abstract expressive motion; the file is a smiley face, not a Luc Chaissac composition
